scope: Implementation and measurement corrections. No model, gate threshold, precision, or answer-based policy tuning.

canonical_input_IDs.reason: Two tokenizer software stacks encoded repeated whitespace differently despite identical checkpoint tokenizer files.
canonical_input_IDs.canonical: Native frontend IDs, independently checked against all 342 completed native pilot records.
canonical_input_IDs.preservation: The original text manifest and mismatched raw records remain unchanged. A separate frozen ID manifest and source-reuse manifest record the correction.

dynamic_no_refill.rule: No token successor enters a new wave until every active token in the current cohort exits.
dynamic_no_refill.admission_order: Original canonical request order, not completion order or predicted depth.
dynamic_no_refill.frozen_values_unchanged: q=0.5, R2-R4, original gate, full R4 prefill, last_exited, BF16.
dynamic_no_refill.timing: Implemented before any Dynamic GPU result.
dynamic_no_refill.packing_limit: Prototype stage calls use B1. The official CDB reference can batch four rows and batches coda after the wave drains.

static_scheduling_scope.task_PP: Preserves the earlier asynchronous whole-request pipeline.
static_scheduling_scope.primary_controlled_replay: Common no-refill token waves on all Static and Dynamic arms.
static_scheduling_scope.qualification: Static task timing is not fully scheduler-matched. Use the separate controlled replay and production-oriented comparisons.

evaluation_scope_400.authority: The user approved approximately 400-500 questions per setting and requested faster completion.
evaluation_scope_400.selection: Retain the frozen 114-question pilot. Add 236 GSM8K and 50 MATH questions with seed 20261021. Use question metadata only.
evaluation_scope_400.unchanged: Checkpoint, BF16, canonical prompt IDs, 4096-token generation cap, greedy decoding, gate, q=0.5, last_exited, and historical numerical failure records.
evaluation_scope_400.limitation: This continuity pilot plus randomized extension is not a uniform random sample of the full suites. Small accuracy differences can remain uncertain.

reporting: Historical strict P512 numerical FAIL remains unchanged. All unresolved numerical serving results remain exploratory.
